description: Search a job’s effective draft Instructions (job_instructions.search): the employer editor’s ranked full-text search (typo-tolerant fallback) over the job’s own instruction set plus the folder set it inherits — exactly what this token reads through inspect and read_page; never a worker’s released view. Returns page groups (up to five block hits each) with stable block ids, anchor ids for deep links, the nearest heading, and inert plain-text snippets with code-point highlight ranges. Hits are ranked inside a bounded window: truncated=true means the window filled — narrow the query rather than page on. Pagination is over the ranked page groups with an opaque cursor bound to the job, the query and the ranked window (a foreign cursor, or one issued before the Instructions changed, fails with INVALID_CURSOR — restart without a cursor). Requires instructions:read.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_search
